# 04 — The seeding interview fills `Me`

**What to build:** a small fixed set of questions about the person, asked during seeding.

Decided in
[ticket 05, a Card for the person themselves](../../memark-p09.6-decisions-only-you-can-make/issues/05-a-card-for-the-person-themselves.md),
part 6. Do not re-argue it.

Five subjects: work, place, health, what they like, and what they avoid.

This is the one Card the interview cannot fill sideways. The interview already lands a lifetime on
Cards for the people, projects and areas the person names, so the box learns about its user as a side
effect of learning about everyone else. That side effect never reaches this Card, because nobody
else's Capture is about them.

Left out, the Card stays empty for months, and those are the same months the box most needs to know
who it is talking to. It is also the period the Checkpoint measures.

The answers are filed like any other Capture and land under the `person` headings from `settings.md`,
so the interview adds no second write path.

**Blocked by:** 01 — `Me`, the second Card reserved by name.
